composition: Fixed full-viewport stage. Comic panels live in a WebGL world; the browser scrollbar dolls the camera sideways through a year. DOM chrome (chapter nav, language) sits on top of the canvas, not in document flow.
typography: Caption and chapter titles set as comic lettering / condensed grotesque over illustrated panels. Not a marketing serif stack. Language toggle EN sits in chrome.
palette: #0d1429 deep navy ground, #cce8eb ice caption color. Two stops. Illustration supplies local color inside panels only.
geometry: Panels sized like printed comic tiers. Chapter changes happen when the camera crosses a gutter. No 12-column marketing grid.
navigation: Chapter list as page navigation, plus continuous scroll as reading. Intro and home are separate beats with their own transitions.
hero: Intro beat before the comic starts — not a product screenshot. Then the first year's first panel is the landing.
motion: Camera drift is 1:1 with scroll. Velocity feeds a smoke shader and audio rate. Chapter transitions scatter panels then align them.
interaction: Halftone cursor trail. Trail radius shrinks on interactive hits. Drag may assist the camera (GSAP Draggable / Observer in the stack).
imagery: Hand-illustrated panels with a different visual character per year. Not stock, not 3D product renders.
materials: Print: halftone, ink navy, paper ice. Shader smoke is atmosphere, not a product material.
spatial_rhythm: Ten chapters of uneven length. Gutters are the pauses. Intro and 'one year later' are extra beats outside the decade.
responsive: A comic camera is fragile on a 390px screen. Expect a vertical panel stack or a simplified swipe-through, with the halftone cursor removed (no cursor on touch).
rejected_defaults: muted corporate navy without the ice ink pairing
autoplaying music with no connection-speed gate
custom cursor larger than 20px that ignores content
